aliases:
- gs
- gswin64c
- gswin32c

- name: unix

  - macos
  - linux
  shells:
  - bash
  - zsh
  - sh
  - fish
  - powershell
  option_style: single_dash_space
  executable_name: ghostscript
  commands:
  - name: convert
    description: Convert between file formats
    options:
    - name: device
      cli: "-sDEVICE"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: equals
    - name: output
      cli: "-sOutputFile"
      type: file
      assignment_delimiter: equals
    - name: resolution
      cli: "-r"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: auto
    - name: first_page
      cli: "-dFirstPage"
      type: integer
      assignment_delimiter: equals
    - name: last_page
      cli: "-dLastPage"
      type: integer
      assignment_delimiter: equals
    - name: pdf_settings
      cli: "-dPDFSETTINGS"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      values:
      - screen
      - ebook
      - printer
      - prepress
      - default
    - name: quality
      cli: "-dJPEGQ"
      type: integer
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      range:
      - 1
      - 100
    - name: text_alpha
      cli: "-dTextAlphaBits"
      type: integer
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      range:
      - 1
      - 4
    - name: graphics_alpha
      cli: "-dGraphicsAlphaBits"
      type: integer
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      range:
      - 1
      - 4
    flags:
    - name: quiet
      cli: "-q"
    - name: batch
      cli: "-dBATCH"
    - name: no_pause
      cli: "-dNOPAUSE"
    - name: no_screen
      cli: "-dNOSAFER"
    arguments:
    - name: inputs
      type: file
      position: last
      variadic: true
    standalone_executable: false
version_detection:
  command:
  - "--version"
  pattern: "(\\d+\\.\\d+)"
  source: command

    - name: quiet

      description: Convert image to grayscale

      assignment_delimiter: space
      description: Replace each pixel with complementary color
    - name: border
      cli: "-border"
      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: space
      description: Surround image with border
    - name: bordercolor

      type: string
      assignment_delimiter: space
      description: Border color

      type: symbol
      assignment_delimiter: equals
      values:

      - ps

      - wmf

      assignment_delimiter: space

    - name: height

    - name: input
